summary: Describes the routing requirements placed on the GMPLS protocol suite so that it can support the capabilities of an Automatically Switched Optical Network (ASON) as defined by the ITU-T. It covers time-division connections such as SONET and SDH and optical transport networks. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A smart optical network needs its map-sharing system to meet certain rules. This memo lists what those rules are for the GMPLS map system.
